== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[One More Pass (Japanese)|One More Pass]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/152940007/LGKMCfeqwEqGMPA7Ql4WfQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 86099782.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>7709a2e983082adfd2ef01f46c77a5bc809ead72c0c71d11527a3de41df30992</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
